statement: Source dated 2025-08-15 reports: The 2025 NAP says climate- and economic-driven migration to Funafuti strains resources and traditional land access, weakening cohesion and raising conflict and civil-unrest risks.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-08-15 reports: The 2025 NAP says climate- and economic-driven migration to Funafuti strains resources and traditional land access, weakening cohesion and raising conflict and civil-unrest risks.

source_refs.locator: Section 5.5.3, printed p. 45, social cohesion and human security discussion.

uncertainty: NAP risk synthesis cites CIVRA 2024; it does not quantify conflict incidence or isolate climate from economic drivers.

statement: Source dated 2025-08-15 reports: The NAP links long dry spells and inadequate storage to water theft and conflict at distribution points; it reports about 70% of the population lacks adequate storage.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-08-15 reports: The NAP links long dry spells and inadequate storage to water theft and conflict at distribution points; it reports about 70% of the population lacks adequate storage.

source_refs.locator: Section 5.5.3, printed p. 46, drought, water security and human-security discussion.

uncertainty: NAP cites Deloitte CIVRA 2024; the 70% denominator is national and conflict frequency or locality is not quantified.

statement: Source dated 2025-08-15 reports: By 2060, current 50-year coastal-flood events may recur every 1-5 years in Funafuti, Nui, Nukufetau and Vaitupu.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-08-15 reports: By 2060, current 50-year coastal-flood events may recur every 1-5 years in Funafuti, Nui, Nukufetau and Vaitupu.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.2.4, printed pp. 24-25, island-specific coastal-inundation projections.

uncertainty: NAP summarizes cited 2023-2024 modeling; frequency and exposure vary by island and remain projections, not observed change.

statement: Source dated 2022-11-10 reports: The preliminary profile says climate pressures can push outer-island residents toward Funafuti, where overcrowding may heighten tensions, while leavers risk loss of place.
compact_statement: Source dated 2022-11-10 reports: The preliminary profile says climate pressures can push outer-island residents toward Funafuti, where overcrowding may heighten tensions, while leavers risk loss of place.

source_refs.locator: Original six-page PDF physical p.4, printed spread pp.6–7, provisional mobility pathway.

uncertainty: Provisional 2022 mechanism; mobility can also create opportunities. Not measured migration/conflict incidence or inevitable destabilization.

statement: Source dated 2022-11-10 reports: The preliminary profile warns that perceived unfair disaster or climate assistance could create grievances and recommends conflict-sensitive planning and aid monitoring.
